name: Hotdogs Sonora
notes: Both photos were legible printed menu boards. Used photo 1 (hot dogs + burgers + extras, 12 items) as the primary source since it is the most complete. Photo 2 showed a second, differently-priced board with overlapping hot dog names (e.g. Hot Dog Regular $6.50 vs $8.00 here) plus a few unique items (Caribe Relleno, Shalchipapa, Orden de Papas, Bebidas) — not merged in since the conflicting prices indicate it's a different/older price list rather than the same menu. Skipped the '+ Fries' combo-price lines on photo 1 as add-on modifiers.
